recognition_primary: 65% mean per-image reference-supported coarse-object F1 across 24 COCO images + 35% target-text recall across eight TextVQA images. Invalid service responses score zero. Counts and paired robustness are separate secondary metrics.
moderation_primary: Equal-category macro F2. Abstained or invalid positive references count as missed detection; unknown references are excluded from Boolean confusion counts and reported separately.
anti_bias: No model-as-judge. Alias dictionary accepts standard equivalent object names; labels came from public annotations plus visual review, without candidate output feedback. OCR matching ignores case/spacing/punctuation but preserves distinct numbers and brands.
limits: One reviewer, small per-category positives, published validation data may have been in model pretraining. No production-certification, movie, multi-image or non-English claim.
owner_data_choice: Use public research datasets for now (user reply, 2026-10-28). Evaluation only, no training approval.
